metadata.chapter: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES

content.title: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES — Sec. 94-164. - Measurement.
content.summary:
Sight distance shall be measured from the center of the approach lane at a point 15
               feet behind the curbline to the center of the nearest approaching traffic lane for
               each direction. (See example below)
(Code 1981, § 30-149; Ord. No. 1544, § 5(B), 3-19-1979)
